description: This file provides utility functions for verifying URL resolution for '/api/users' endpoint in a development or testing context. It constructs expected API URLs based on organization ID, logs the URL, and includes a smoke test function to demonstrate resolution with a specific organization ID.

methods.name: verifyUsersUrlResolution(organizationIdOverride = null)
methods.description: Constructs and logs the expected API URL for '/api/users', optionally simulating an organization override. Used for runtime verification during development.

methods.name: quickUsersResolutionSmoke()
methods.description: A helper function that tests and logs the URL resolution for a specific organization ID ('T0015') without mutating state afterward.
